claim: For the non-finite modifiers in [15ii–iv], see Ch. 14, §8.2.
evidence_summary: Ch. 14 §8.2 (p. 1259) is “Non-finite complements of nouns”. §9 (p. 1264), “Non-finite clauses as modifiers and supplements”, opens with near-copies of [15iii–iv].
inference: Does the reference lead to the treatment of non-finite modifiers?

evidence.establishes: The reference points to the section on complements.
